rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides remote desktop control and automation for Windows machines through a tiered security model. Tier 1 offers read-only operations like screenshots and system info, Tier 2 adds interactive capabilities such as mouse/keyboard control and window management, and Tier 3 enables destructive operations like PowerShell execution, file modification, and registry editing. Supports both stdio and HTTP transports with optional Bearer token authentication and IP allowlisting for secure remote access.
